purpose: Candidate sources for the NeuroYadro Russian base model. Every source must be reviewed before use; only the listed git commit is accepted by the acquisition tool.

sources.content: Russian mass-media corpus: repository README declares about 1.5M articles / 360M words, stored as bzip2 parts and already stemmed.
sources.quality: Base-language pretraining only. Stemming removes inflectional detail, so this source must be mixed with non-stemmed, licence-reviewed text before any quality claim.

sources.content: Small corpus of Russian acceptability judgments.
sources.quality: Evaluation and targeted fine-tuning candidate, not a base-pretraining source. Check individual cited source conditions before redistributing weights.

sources.content: Collection of Russian NLP task datasets including dialogues and QA material.
sources.quality: Targeted instruction/evaluation mix only; select individual subsets and check their provenance before inclusion.

sources.content: Large Russian news corpus in CoNLL-U according to the project README; the data download is hosted outside GitHub.
sources.quality: Manual acquisition only: verify current data-host terms and source-article rights before placing a downloaded file in the local corpus.
